story_text:
## Your favorite photo. A few words that matter.
Loopi is a 21 g, six-color E-Paper display for your photos, drawings and messages. Choose a picture or create a text card in myLoopi, then send it to Loopi over Bluetooth. Carry it with the included strap; selected rewards add the planned magnet upgrade for suitable magnetic surfaces.
[画像: An original close-up of the Loopi prototype displaying a family photo]
Original photograph · October 7, 2026. A family photo on our existing magnetic prototype; the display content is unchanged. The planned Base version has no magnet and has not yet been photographed.
Loopi and myLoopi are in development. The photographs and tests show our working prototypes and iOS development build. Public iOS and Android releases are planned; final production versions are still being prepared.
## Choose. Create. Send.
[画像: Original myLoopi screens: start, create, and explore]
Original myLoopi screenshots · October 8, 2026, arranged as an explanatory overview. They show an earlier development build; public iOS and Android releases are planned.
- Choose your own photo, write a message or start with an editable template.
- Adjust brightness, contrast and sharpness, preview the design and save a look locally on your phone.
- Send over Bluetooth with your phone near Loopi. Optional Home Connect adds the remote route through a Home Hub.
myLoopi is free for Kickstarter backers across all six rewards, with no subscription for the app features described for their reward. Public app-store releases are still planned.
The tested display uses black, white, yellow, red, green and blue. Photos are prepared for this palette using image patterns, so the matte E-Paper result can look different from your phone preview.
[画像: The yellow Loopi Pet on the real display]
Original photograph of our existing magnetic prototype with the yellow Loopi Pet on its real display. The display content is unchanged; the Base version without a magnet is still being prepared.
Loopi Pet is our own yellow loop-shaped character. The app prototype lets you personalize its look with a name, mood or details, then send it as a still image.
## Watch a real Bluetooth transfer.
These two continuous recordings from October 15, 2026 show myLoopi and the physical Loopi together, from choosing a design to the finished display update. Audio was removed; no cuts, speed changes or AI imagery were added. Test 2 was rotated upright.
Test 1 — colors, designs, weather and a price snapshot · 5:12
Includes the six-color pattern, personal designs, Paris weather and an ETH price card. Weather and price data appear as images.
Test 2 — a chosen design and Berlin weather · 2:55
Loopi displays one image at a time. Photos, notes, dates and weather are sent as images; updating the information requires another image transfer. Transfers take time, and the last image stays visible until a new transfer completes. These films demonstrate the Bluetooth workflow; they do not show the optional internet-to-hub route described below.
## A small card for your day.
- On your bag: carry a family photo or a drawing from your child with the included strap.
- On your fridge: keep “Milk. Bread. Water the plants.” in sight. Choose a magnet reward and a suitable magnetic surface.
- At home through optional Home Connect: send a photo, “Back at six” or “PE tomorrow — pack your trainers” while you are away.
[画像: Three original prototype photographs: a white Loopi showing the Mona Lisa held in a hand, a close-up of its green lanyard connector and top slot, and a close-up of a metal clip attached to a bag strap and Loopi slot.]
Original prototype photos, cropped into one layout. Device, hand and display content are unchanged. Attachment details show sample accessories; these photos do not define the promised package contents. This sample has a magnet; Base is planned without one.
## Optional Home Connect: send a card home.
Home Connect adds a touchscreen Home Hub for the Loopi you leave at home. Your phone sends a photo or text card over the internet; the hub passes it to Loopi over Bluetooth. The hub stays powered through USB-C and connected to your 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi and internet. Your phone needs internet, and Loopi must be within Bluetooth range of the hub.
[画像: Original photo of our Loopi and touchscreen Home Hub prototypes, with their actual weather screens]
Original hardware photograph supplied on October 20, 2026, showing the actual weather screens on both prototypes. This still does not prove a remote app-to-Loopi delivery. The final hub enclosure remains in development.
What our prototype tests have shown
Our prototype tests have delivered photos and text from a phone using mobile data. We also tested retrying an interrupted text transfer. Sleep recovery and connection reliability still need further testing. Some sleep states may require someone at home to wake Loopi with its button before a new card can arrive; unattended delivery is not guaranteed.
You create and send each card yourself. These notes do not trigger timed alarms, and delivery confirmation does not mean someone has read them. The photographs and app preview here are separate records, not a continuous film of the remote route.
Set up the hub. Send from your phone.
Our tested iPhone setup follows four steps:
- Power the Home Hub with an existing USB-C cable and adapter, then choose your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi on its touchscreen.
- Wake Loopi and connect it on the hub’s Bluetooth screen. Keep both devices within Bluetooth range.
- Scan the hub’s pairing QR code with your iPhone camera and open it in myLoopi.
- Create a photo or text card, choose the home receiver and send. Your phone needs internet; the hub stays powered and online.
[画像: Original German myLoopi preview showing the selected ESP at home delivery option]
Original myLoopi development screenshot supplied on October 20, 2026. The German “ESP zu Hause” selects the home receiver. This send preview alone does not prove physical delivery.
Home Connect includes one Loopi with magnet upgrade, one carrying strap, one Qi charger and one Home Hub with its own touchscreen. Use your existing USB-C cable and power adapter; neither is included. The final hub enclosure and Qi charger model remain to be confirmed. Family Pack does not include a Home Hub.
## Choose your Loopi.
The three Base price levels contain the same planned device and strap. All six rewards include myLoopi at no extra charge, with no subscription for the app features described for that reward. Public iOS and Android releases are planned.
- Photo Special — €49
1 Loopi · no magnet · 1 carrying strap · no Qi charger · no Home Hub.
- Base Early Bird — €79
1 Loopi · no magnet · 1 carrying strap · no Qi charger · no Home Hub.
- Essential — €89
1 Loopi · no magnet · 1 carrying strap · no Qi charger · no Home Hub.
- Plus — €99
1 Loopi with magnet upgrade · 2 carrying straps · no Qi charger · no Home Hub.
- Home Connect — €149
1 Loopi with magnet upgrade · 1 carrying strap · 1 Qi charger · 1 Home Hub with its own touchscreen.
- Family Pack — €199
2 Loopi, each with magnet upgrade · 4 carrying straps · 1 Qi charger · no Home Hub.
Prices include VAT. Tracked shipping per parcel: Germany €7; other EU countries €18; rest of the world €29. Additional local taxes or import duties may apply outside the EU. Every shipment will have a tracking number.
A Qi charger is included only in Home Connect and Family Pack; its model remains to be selected. Base and Plus do not include one. Home Connect uses your existing USB-C cable and power adapter; neither is included. Remote image delivery requires the Home Hub included in Home Connect.
Photo Special and Early Bird are campaign-only offers. Late pledges are planned for Essential, Plus, Home Connect and Family Pack at the same listed prices. Installment payments are not planned.
## Small, light and rechargeable.
- Body: 101 × 62 × 3.3 mm; device weight 21 g without carrying straps or accessories.
- Display: 3.6-inch E-Paper, 400 × 600 pixels; display area 50.8 × 76.2 mm.
- Charging: Qi on our tested prototype.
Dimensions, display area and IP67 come from the approved product sheet. An independent IP67 test report has not been provided. Final production versions and accessory compatibility still need testing.
[画像: A genuine photograph of the Loopi prototype on the charging pad, displaying IN MEINEM TEMPO. (AT MY OWN PACE.)]
Original photograph · October 15, 2026. Our prototype on the charging pad, with its actual display content unchanged. This photograph does not document a complete, timed 0-to-100-percent charging cycle.
In our own sample tests, charging from 0 to 100% took under 15 minutes and battery life reached up to three months, depending on use and image changes. Test conditions and the charger model are not fully documented. These are team-reported prototype results, not independent measurements or guaranteed production performance; compatibility with every Qi charger is not established. No Qi2 or MagSafe certification is claimed.
## From prototype to the first production run.
Loopi is a project from Blackhaus E-Com GmbH in Berlin. We develop myLoopi and are working with a manufacturer in China on the final device versions.
- Demonstrated on prototypes: Bluetooth image transfers, six display colors and remote photo/text transfers through the Home Hub.
- Final samples and testing: prepare Base and magnet samples; test accessories and batteries, connections, sleep recovery and remote-service security.
- App preparation: Android testing and public app-store releases.
- Production: production approval, manufacturing, quality control, packaging and tracked shipping.
Our €3,500 funding goal supports preparation and manufacturing of the first run, alongside app development. The minimum goal is not a full project-cost estimate.
Loopi is now live on Kickstarter. The campaign ends on November 23, 2026 at 17:21 CET. Estimated delivery is early 2027. January 2027 is entered as a provisional reward delivery month; the manufacturer’s production lead time is not yet confirmed. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date. Components, testing, production and transport can affect the schedule; we will keep backers informed of significant changes.
Choose the version that fits your day and help us prepare the first Loopi production run.
## More from the app development build.
App screen recording — editing, Loopi Pet and transfer status · 3:18
Original screen recording from October 15, 2026, with audio removed. It shows the iPhone screen; the physical device is visible in the two continuous Bluetooth tests near the start of this story.
An earlier edited app overview
Original screenshots and explanatory graphics, including a short Higgsfield AI-generated intro. This is a designed overview, not a continuous transfer test. The dated app captures retain their original German interface.
## About the images and films.
The main project image is an AI-assisted advertising composition created with Higgsfield, based on our prototype references. The phone contains an original myLoopi app screenshot, scaled and cropped for the layout. It is not an unchanged product photograph, a shared scale reference or a remote-transfer test. Package images are AI-assisted cartoon illustrations of the planned contents, not photographs of finished production packages. Any charger symbol is schematic; the charger model and final hub enclosure remain to be confirmed.
The story uses original prototype photographs and dated app captures. Our existing photographed sample has a magnet; the planned Base version has no magnet. The reward images are cartoon illustrations of the planned package contents, rather than product photographs. Captions identify the evidence and its limits.

faq.a: A small, six-color E-Paper display for your photos, drawings and messages. Create a card in myLoopi and send it by Bluetooth. Working prototypes exist; hardware, app and the first production run are still in development.

faq.q: Is myLoopi free? Do I need a subscription?
faq.a:
All six Loopi rewards include myLoopi free, with no subscription for the app features described for your reward. This includes Photo Special and Early Bird. Home Connect adds the Home Hub needed for remote delivery.

The app is in development. Public iOS and Android releases are planned.

faq.q: What is Home Connect, and how do I set it up?
faq.a:
The €149 package includes 1 Loopi with magnet upgrade, 1 strap, 1 Qi charger and 1 Home Hub with its own touchscreen.

Our tested iPhone setup:
1. Power the hub with your own USB-C cable and adapter (not included). Select your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi on its touchscreen.
2. Wake Loopi and connect it on the hub’s Bluetooth screen.
3. Scan the hub’s QR code with your iPhone camera to pair myLoopi.
4. Create a photo or text card, choose the home receiver and send.

Your phone needs internet; the hub stays pow…

faq.q: Does my phone need to stay near Loopi or keep the app open?
faq.a:
For direct transfers, keep myLoopi open and connected to Loopi by Bluetooth.

With Home Connect, your phone can be elsewhere. It sends the card over the internet to the powered, online Home Hub, which relays it by Bluetooth. Remote photos and text have worked in prototype tests. Some sleep states still need a local press of Loopi’s button; recovery is being tested, so unattended delivery is not guaranteed.

Delivery confirmation is not a read receipt. Notes do not trigger timed alarms.

faq.q: Can I use my own photos, text and templates?
faq.a: Yes. The app prototype has photo and text editors, editable templates and looks saved locally on your phone. Personal photos have been sent to the real Loopi. Dates, times, to-do lists and weather are prepared as display images. Final-version testing is still to come.

faq.q: What is included in Base and Plus?
faq.a:
Base: 1 Loopi without a magnet + 1 carrying strap. No charging cable, charger, stand, clip, skin or magnet upgrade.

Plus (€99): 1 Loopi with magnet upgrade + 2 carrying straps. No Qi charger.

faq.q: What are the prices and shipping costs?
faq.a:
Prices include VAT:
• Photo Special €49: Base contents.
• Early Bird €79 and Essential €89: Base contents.
• Plus €99: 1 Loopi with magnet upgrade + 2 straps.
• Home Connect €149: 1 Loopi with magnet upgrade + 1 strap + 1 Qi charger + 1 touchscreen Home Hub.
• Family Pack €199: 2 Loopi with magnet upgrades + 4 straps + 1 Qi charger; no Home Hub.

Tracked shipping per parcel: Germany €7; other EU €18; rest of world €29. Extra taxes or import duties may apply outside the EU.

faq.q: Which Loopi versions have a magnet?
faq.a: The photographed prototype has a magnet. Base is planned without one; selected rewards include the paid magnet upgrade. Use a suitable magnetic surface for refrigerator attachment. The final upgrade is still being tested; compatibility with every phone or case is not established.

faq.q: Do the clock and weather update automatically?
faq.a:
Each update requires a new image transfer; Loopi keeps its last image until the next transfer finishes.

For direct phone updates, myLoopi must be open and connected in our tested setup. The Home Hub prototype has also updated clock and weather images without a connected phone. It needs USB-C power, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi/internet and Loopi within Bluetooth range. Sleep and interruption recovery remain in testing.

faq.q: How long does the battery last, and how is it charged?
faq.a:
Our own sample tests reached up to three months of battery life, depending on use and image changes, and 0–100% Qi charging in under 15 minutes. Connection activity also affects battery use.

These are team-reported prototype results, not independent measurements or guaranteed production performance. Update frequency, other test conditions and the charger model are not fully documented. faq.a:
Working magnetic Loopi and iPhone-app prototypes exist. Continuous tests from October 15, 2026 show real image transfers and completed display updates; another recording shows the app screen. Original captures retain their German interface.

A separate Base sample without a magnet has not yet been photographed. Final hardware, Android testing, charging, battery-life and interruption tests, app store releases and production approval are still to come.

Delivery is estimated for early 2027. January 2027 is the provisional reward delivery month; the manufacturer’s production lead time is not yet confirmed. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date. Testing, production approval and transport can affect the schedule. We will keep backers informed of significant changes.
